verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say scripts can be deployed as serverless Functions that you can "invoke and schedule anywhere," which is a first-party claim of scheduling deployed automations. The evidence is a single marketing-level line, plus a truncated Functions concept page. It does not show that recurring schedules are configured natively in Notte rather than through an external scheduler. missing for 10: documented recurring/cron schedule configuration, schedule management (list/pause/edit), run history for scheduled jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
